description: This file contains advanced unit tests for the Orleans task scheduler, including tests for task execution order, context propagation, fault handling, and scheduler behavior within the Orleans runtime environment.

classes.name: OrleansTaskSchedulerAdvancedTests
classes.description: A test class providing advanced unit tests for Orleans task scheduler functionality, including execution order, context propagation, fault handling, and scheduler behavior.

methods.name: Sched_AC_Test
methods.description: Tests that multiple tasks queued in the scheduler execute serially, verifying no concurrent execution occurs.

methods.name: Sched_AC_WaitTest
methods.description: Tests task waiting and synchronization, ensuring tasks complete within a timeout and in the correct order.

methods.name: Sched_AC_Turn_Execution_Order
methods.description: Verifies that a long-running turn completes before other spawned tasks start, ensuring turn-based execution semantics.

methods.name: Sched_Stopped_WorkItemGroup
methods.description: Tests behavior of the scheduler's work item group after stopping, ensuring tasks are handled correctly.

methods.name: Sched_Task_Turn_Execution_Order
methods.description: Checks that a long-running turn completes before other tasks are scheduled, verifying turn isolation.

methods.name: Sched_AC_Current_TaskScheduler
methods.description: Verifies that the current task scheduler context is correctly propagated within nested tasks.

methods.name: Sched_AC_ContinueWith_1_Test
methods.description: Tests continuation tasks' fault handling and execution order within the scheduler.

methods.name: Sched_Task_JoinAll
methods.description: Tests that Task.WhenAll correctly waits for multiple tasks to complete and verifies their results.

methods.name: Sched_AC_ContinueWith_2_OrleansSched
methods.description: Verifies that faulted tasks trigger the appropriate continuation handlers within the scheduler.

methods.name: Sched_Task_SchedulingContext
methods.description: Ensures that the scheduling context is correctly propagated across task continuations and nested tasks.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Helper method for logging diagnostic information during tests.

methods.name: CheckRuntimeContext
methods.description: Validates that the runtime context matches the expected scheduling context.
